question.text: Per Chapter 9, syndicate investments are permitted ONLY for which investor class under SEBI (AIF) Regulations?

answer.text: Only Accredited Investors — the Lead Investor must ensure every investor meets the SEBI Accredited Investor Framework.

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9 explicitly: 'As per SEBI (Alternative Investment Funds) Regulations, only Accredited Investors are permitted to invest in the syndicate deals. Hence, the lead investor will be required to ensure every investor is in compliance with the Accredited Investor Framework, as specified by SEBI.' The Trap: Option B violates the AI-only restriction. Options C and D are unrelated sub-categories. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A tests the Accredited Investor threshold at distributor level. XXI-A (PMS Distributors) has similar KYC thresholds but not AI-specific. X-A/X-B (IA) reference AI status for segregated advice. Manager's Pro-Tip: Keep AI certificates (issued by the AI Accreditation Agencies) on file before onboarding. Certificates have an expiry — renew the lead-investor validation annually and document the refresh, else SEBI can argue an onboarding compliance breach.
